note: Every asset is authored and shipped at 1x. Scale with integers only.

scene.name: The Slagfen
scene.blurb: Where the refinery dumped what it could not use. The ground is still warm eleven years on.

heroes.name: Rell
heroes.blurb: Holds the line while the sigils charge. Plate steel, wine tabard, a blade older than the refinery.

heroes.name: Iska
heroes.blurb: Reads a machine the way a physician reads a pulse. Brass goggles, oiled coat, a spanner she swings.

heroes.name: Maren
heroes.blurb: Speaks to the things that live between the veils. Ash-pale, indigo-robed, always the last to move.

heroes.name: Tessin
heroes.blurb: Came down off the mooring towers and never quite landed. Storm-teal scarf, harness leather, two knives.

monsters.name: Slagmaw
monsters.blurb: Sleeps in the cooling slag until something warm walks past. The cracks in its plates never went out.

monsters.name: Cinderwisp
monsters.blurb: What is left when a furnace-hand forgets to come home. Follows lantern light. Will not be spoken to.

monsters.name: Gloamstag
monsters.blurb: Walks the Deepstone galleries where the moss still glows. Its antlers are older than its body.

monsters.name: Fluewyrm
monsters.blurb: Nests in the cold flues and comes down when they stoke. Iron scale, and a temper about the heat.

monsters.name: Ashgrieve
monsters.blurb: A furnace-hand who never came up. Still walking the shift, still carrying the light it died holding.

items.name: Emberglass Vial
items.blurb: Bottled furnace-light. Drink it and the cold stops mattering for a while.

items.name: Cogwright's Spanner
items.blurb: Iska's own, re-forged twice. Turns a bolt and breaks a jaw.

items.name: Voidcaller's Focus
items.blurb: The crystal was cut from a veil-fall. It hums when something is listening.

items.name: Warden Seal
items.blurb: Struck for the last basin wardens. Nine were made; four are accounted for.

items.name: Slag Ingot
items.blurb: Refinery tailings, re-poured. Still warm in the middle if you split it.

items.name: Ashroot
items.blurb: Grows only where the ground burned. Bitter, and the only thing that grows here.
